title: DIVINE CONFIDENCE
content:
Filled with expectancy,
I conceive glory.

Not because the stars bow before me,
but because I’m carried in divine promise.

As the sea waves rise,
I am anchored to an unmovable Rock.

Even if Josephed for silver,
my soul bears witness that The Redeemer is near.

I lift my eyes unto the hills,
and behold the hand of Providence.

Carving His name upon the pathways of my soul,
my heart attests that I am carried on the wings of grace, moving toward a glorious destiny.

title: AFTER THE MESSAGE
content:
Wandering in thought for a decade,
I felt compelled to send the message.

As a happy bird chirps and sings joyfully in the morning,
what felt like an empty room overflowed with jubilation from a whisper.

For a brief moment, jubilation made its home within my heart.

Now, the once joyful soul is fading,
Fading and fading from within.

The echo won’t stop repeating.
A loud whisper that once brought jubilation has now become an echo.

Sitting beneath towering bamboo trees, I ponder a simple truth:
“Letting our companionship drift away like withered leaves is the surest path.”

Though the stars drift apart, our radiance shall forever reign supreme.

As the morning sun shines,
our hearts may meet where distance cannot.
